what: Logo sticker pieces (two-line title, speech bubble, picture tile) stick on one by one over .6s, starting at 1.4x and transparent — at 20% they reach full size and opacity, at 50% they bounce once to 1.1x, and settle at 1x (per-piece delays .2·.6·1·1.3·1.5s). With wobble on, the whole board then settles with three nods at perspective 1000px (X·Y −8·−3° .1s → 0 .2s → Y −6° .1s → 0 .2s → 8·−3° .1s → 0 .4s) — the sticker logo and start button entrance of a kids’ learning site

options.over: One-bounce scale, default 1.1 — for picture tiles, the piece’s data-over="1.06"
options.dur: Time for one piece to attach (sec), default .6
options.ease: Segment curve, default 0.215,0.61,0.355,1 (power2.out if no CustomEase)
options.wobble: When the whole panel starts tilting in 3D (s) — if omitted it does not sway. Original logo 1.25
options.[data-fx-part=piece]: Snap-on piece — data-delay (seconds)·data-over (bounce ratio)·data-origin (axis, e.g. "363px 150px"Can attach ). If absent, the element itself gets it

use: <svg data-fx="sticker-slap-in" data-fx-sticker-slap-in="wobble: 1.25"><g data-fx-part="piece" data-delay=".2">…</g><g data-fx-part="piece" data-delay=".6">…</g></svg>
